ROOFING SERVICES

The right work.
The right roof.

From targeted repairs to a complete replacement, start with the condition of the property and a clear scope.

01

Residential Roofing

From a persistent leak to a complete re-roof, the right starting point is a clear assessment of your existing roof, the home beneath it, and the work you want to accomplish.

Explore +02

Commercial Roofing

Commercial roof work needs a plan for drainage, access, occupied spaces, and day-to-day operations. Near Shore Roofing offers commercial roofing and membrane installation in its stated service region.

Explore +03

Roof Repair

A water stain does not always sit directly below the roof opening. Water can travel along framing or under roofing before it appears indoors. A useful repair starts by tracing that path.

Explore +04

Roof Replacement

Replacing a roof is a chance to address worn roofing and the details beneath it. Compare complete scopes rather than choosing on the price of the visible material alone.

Explore +05

New Roof Installation

New construction calls for coordination between the roof design, supporting structure, chosen materials, and other trades. Establish the roofing scope early so transitions and penetrations receive proper attention.

Explore +06

Metal Roofing

Metal roofing can suit Florida homes with a crisp architectural profile. Its performance depends on the complete assembly, including the panel profile, finish, fasteners, flashings, and installation.

Explore +07

Tile Roofing

Tile gives a home a distinctive silhouette, but the visible tile is only part of the roof. Underlayment, flashings, support, and drainage details deserve just as much attention.

Explore +08

Shingle Roofing

Asphalt shingles offer a wide range of colors and profiles for residential roofs. A dependable installation includes more than a shingle choice: the deck, underlayment, starter, edges, ventilation, and flashings must work together.

Explore +09

Membrane Roofing

Membrane roofing is used on many low-slope commercial and residential assemblies. Roof slope, drainage, insulation, existing conditions, and penetrations help determine the right specification.

Explore +010

Storm Damage Roof Repair

If wind or heavy rain has affected your roof, prioritize safety and document what you can see from the ground. Contact Near Shore Roofing to discuss an assessment and the available repair options.

Explore +011

Roof & Gutter Cleaning

Leaves and debris can interrupt drainage and hide roof details that need attention. Near Shore Roofing lists roof and gutter cleaning among its services.
